title: Squared Smoke
body:
# Campfire Smoke Replacement (1.21–1.21.1)
This resource pack replaces only the smoke particles from campfires with clean white square particles. Everything else in the game remains untouched, making it a minimal and highly compatible visual tweak for players who want clearer, more stylized campfire effects without altering the rest of their world.


## What’s Changed
•	Campfire smoke is replaced with simple white square particles.
•	Designed to blend seamlessly with both vanilla visuals and other packs.


## Compatibility
•	Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.21–1.21.1.
•	Works alongside OptiFine, Sodium, Iris, and shader packs.
•	Safe to combine with any other resource pack that doesn’t modify campfire smoke textures.
